content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to its end and is now stopped in front of the green panel, about 0.4 m away according to the sonar. I called `rest`, so it has crouched with the motors off.

The corridor turned left twice before the panel came into view. The robot's collision protection stopped the walk at each turn. Once it was pressed against the right-hand wall, so I backed off slightly and sidestepped before the last stretch. There were no falls.
